lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: All of it. Every derivation, in order, including the four I was wrong about — which are the useful ones, because a wrong derivation tells you what somebody was thinking and a right one only tells you what they concluded.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: And they were not burning these because they are dangerous. They were burning them because storage costs money and nobody had signed for the crate. That is somehow very much worse.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Take the slate as well. It was in the crate, it is not on any manifest, and as far as this camp's records are concerned it does not exist.
